# Delivery — The Binding Wall

How the payload physically reaches the target cell in vivo: LNP vs AAV vs virion vs cell carriers, biodistribution, and penetration of the tumor microenvironment. This is the pipeline's binding constraint — median 0.7% of dose reaches a solid tumor, 1–2% escapes the endosome. The 2024–26 wins bypass the wall (aim at the liver, inject locally, hit blood cells) rather than break it.
